_comment: Team-approved tuning for lecture-forge. This file syncs through the repo,
so a change here changes everyone's edits — it is the file a tuning pull
request touches. Anything absent falls back to the code defaults in
scripts/, which are the shipped values and always safe to fall back to.
Local experiments belong in ~/.lecture-forge/config.json instead, and
per-camera facts (board box, room chatter) belong in a room profile.

gaps._comment: Seconds of pause allowed, by what the pause is doing.

clip._comment: Bounds on a proposed clip, in seconds.
